data.question: May we know where to buy TCL Air Purifier Filter?
data.answer: You could buy it within TCL official store

data.question: I have to use filter from TCL or I can user filter from other brands?
data.answer: Yes, you have to. TCL filter is using true HEPA 13 and quality is reliable.

data.question: How long can a filter work?
data.answer: It can work 3-6 months. We recommend you replace a new filter every 3-6 months

data.question: How do we know when to replace Filter
data.answer:
There is a filter light indicator. When the LED indicator starts showing yellow, it means you need to prepare buying a new filter. When the LED indicator starts showing red, it means that filter cannot work, although the air purifier can still work.
We recommend you buying a new filter before yellow light ON, better to buy filter together when you buy air purifier.

data.question: How do we know if air purifier is working
data.answer: You could have air purifier run over 12 hours, and then open it to check filter if it's getting dirty or not. But this is depended on your circumstance.

data.question: What room size can this air purifier can cover?
data.answer: The Air purifier CADR 120M3/H, it can cover 15M2~20M2

data.question: Does this air purifier support removal of PM 2.5?
I want to buy an air purifier for my bedroom, but have worries that it will be noisy
data.answer: You can set it sleep mode and it will be very quiet ( only 20dB in sleep mode)
